title: Normalized Cultivar Batch Analyte Profile
description: Normalized representation of one cannabis batch's laboratory analyte measurements. A batch profile is the unit of truth for connecting cultivar labels to measured chemistry. Censoring states (nd, below_lod, below_loq, not_tested) are never collapsed or silently imputed as zero. Batch identity (batch_id, the producer's batch identifier) and report identity (lab_report_id, the canonical lab-results/TLAB-XXXX report record) are distinct: one batch may have retests, corrected reports, multiple panels, or reports from different laboratories. Analyte measurements carry their own units; mixed units within a batch are allowed and are only compared/composed after explicit normalization into a compatible analyte subset. See docs/graph/cultivar-chemotype-model.md.

batch_id.description: Producer/operator batch identifier (natural key as printed on the product or provided by the producer). Stable across retests; one batch may be covered by several laboratory reports.

lab_report_id.description: Canonical archive record id for the laboratory report (COA), e.g. lab-results/TLAB-0101. Distinct from batch_id: one batch may have retests, corrected reports, multiple panels, or reports from different laboratories.

oneOf.description: Canonical producer organization id, e.g. organizations/TORG-0001.
Null when the producer is unknown.

producer_id.description: Canonical producer organization id, e.g. organizations/TORG-XXXX, or null when unknown. Must be actual JSON null, never the string "null".

oneOf.description: Canonical commercial product id, e.g. products/TPRD-0001.
Null when the product is unknown.

product_id.description: Canonical commercial product id, e.g. products/TPRD-XXXX, or null when unknown. Must be actual JSON null, never the string "null".

items.description: Cultivar label exactly as printed on the product/report. Never collapsed or canonicalized at ingest.

basis.description: Reporting basis. Cross-batch comparison requires explicit normalization to dry-weight.

decarb_convention.description: native = acids and neutrals reported separately; total-potential = acid converted (e.g., THCA x 0.877 + THC).

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction where the batch was tested, e.g. CA, MA. Used for jurisdiction-dependence metrics.

record_kind.description: verified = real COA; demonstration = sample/placeholder record that must be excluded from derived statistics; unverified = real-looking but unverified record, also excluded from derived statistics. Derived statistics use only record_kind == verified.

compound_id.description: Canonical compound entity id, e.g. cannabinoids/TCBN-0007 or terpenes/TTRP-0005. Identity is keyed on the entity id, never the display name.

value.description: Required and numeric only when censoring == numeric; otherwise must be null.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for this analyte. A batch may contain multiple units (e.g. % w/w cannabinoids, mg/g terpenes, ppm pesticides); measurements are only compared/composed after explicit normalization into a compatible analyte subset.

censoring.description: numeric = fully quantified; nd = not detected; below_lod / below_loq = censored below a limit; not_tested = absent from the panel.

lod.description: Method limit of detection in the same unit. Required when censoring == below_lod.

loq.description: Method limit of quantitation in the same unit. Required when censoring == below_loq.

method.description: Analytical method, e.g. HPLC-UV, GC-MS, LC-MS/MS.
